_doc: Question 3 (prose fiction / literary argument) title lists printed in the AP English Literature and Composition free-response PDFs, 2023 to 2026, as listed on https://apcentral.collegeboard.org/courses/ap-english-literature-and-composition/exam/past-exam-questions. Each PDF was downloaded and its question-3 list read by READ FRANCE on 2026-10-17 (pdftotext); `titles` = which Chapter Checks titles are printed in that list, `count` = number of works in the list. Topic: our paraphrase of the prompt. 2026: one set published at the date checked. The 4 free quiz titles (jekyll-hyde, heart-of-darkness, othello, importance-of-being-earnest) were searched in the same 7 PDFs on 2026-10-21 (pdftotext): Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde is in 2023 set 1, The Importance of Being Earnest in 2025 set 1, the other two in none.

lists.topic: a character who intentionally creates a new identity
a rebel character who disrupts the existing state of societal, familial or political affairs
a character who is reluctant, unable or resistant to make a decision
a character who senses that something important is lacking in life
characters significantly affected by memories of the past
a character who holds a secret
a conflict between the old and the new
